short_description: Six printable play sets for ages 0–5, every stage from birth to 5 in one download, plus 16 play coupons. Color and low-ink, Letter and A4.
long_description:
Six printable play sets for ages 0–5, every stage from birth to 5, plus a book of play coupons, all included in one instant download from our own shop. Color and low-ink, US Letter and A4.

Inside: 100 Screen-Free Plays sorted by stage, 52 Play & Talk Cards (one for every week of the year), Visual Routine Cards with the ages 0–5 cards, the Toddler Busy Book with 74 activities, 76 “I’m Bored” play cards for ages 1–5, and the Play-First Family Kit with its ages 2–5 pages. The Play Coupons set, also included, adds 16 coupons for plays to do together.

Start with the set for your child’s age today; the rest waits until you need it. Every set has its own START HERE page, grown-up guide and safety page. Most plays use things you already have.

It is ready to give: a fold card and two “Surprise! Inside is…” reveal cards list every set, and the license passes to the family who receives it.

Every play follows our published safety rules. Digital files in English; nothing is shipped. Personal license for one household.

faq.a: 100 Screen-Free Plays, 52 Play & Talk Cards, Visual Routine Cards (includes the 0–5 cards), the Toddler Busy Book (74 activities), “I’m Bored” Play Cards (76 for ages 1–5), the Play-First Family Kit (includes its ages 2–5 pages) and a free Play Coupons set, plus library pages with a fold card and reveal cards.

Instant download: nothing ships. You get a START HERE page and ZIP files. On a computer, double-click a ZIP to open it; on a phone, tap it in your files app. On a phone, download in a web browser, not the shopping app.

faq.q: Can I give it as a gift?
faq.a: Yes. Print the fold card or a reveal card, or forward the download. The personal license passes to the family who receives it.
Pick Letter or A4, color or low-ink. Each set’s START HERE says which pages to print first.
No. The library is too large for Etsy’s file limits, so it is sold in our own shop. On Etsy, look for the Ages 1–5 Instant Gift Bundle.

faq.q: Can I buy the sets on their own?
faq.a: Yes, each set is also sold on its own. The library costs less than buying the six counted sets separately.
Every play follows our published safety rules and has its own safety line. You know your child best: skip anything that doesn’t suit them.
No. These are everyday play ideas for families. Questions about your child’s growth or health? Your child’s doctor is a good place to start.
Digital downloads follow the shop’s published refund policy. If a file won’t open or print, we fix it or send it again.
